description: This file implements the RunC container management class and related functionalities, including container creation, execution, state retrieval, and termination, using the runc runtime. It defines classes for container info, configuration, and the runner that interfaces with the runc executable.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates the interaction with the runc executable, providing methods to create, execute, delete, and query container states.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Holds container process ID and status information, serializable to/from JSON.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including process environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variables for the container process.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Implements the container interface for a runc-based container, managing its lifecycle and querying status.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Reads environment variables from the host and adds them to the container options based on the config file.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.
